The watch aside now uses a comma, so the earlier raya objection no longer applies.","evidenceIds":["target"]},{"issueId":"315768696d3ce46d6c1f","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The source’s teetering, historical evidence and hand-wringing now become «se tambalea», «repasemos el historial» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». These lose the English receipt wordplay but restore the intended meanings in natural Spanish; the watch joke remains.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5572829f87714878b51","verdict":"uphold","severity":2,"reason":"«En los años 80 se tachó…» fixes the English-shaped opening. «Y todo ello evitando el tráfico» still pads the source’s brisk «all while avoiding traffic», though it is understandable and does not block publication.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"1435bb2e0747e30736dc","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«A cada generación le toca su monstruo tecnológico: aparece un aparato nuevo» combines and recasts the source’s first two sentences; «No vaya a ser que tengamos que mirar un reloj de agujas» gives the analog joke a local cadence. The rewrite loses the specific ‘bogeyman’ image and gains a more natural opening while keeping the panic and watch joke.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5aaf12f0080c249d21c","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The target now retains «date: 2025-05-31» from the source. Its «sourceHash: \"d5356a63e570\"» differs from the supplied full source digest, but the packet does not establish that these fields use the same hashing convention; the claimed staleness failure remains unproven.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"fd937904d69ce522a613","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Cuándo la IA amplifica el aprendizaje y cuándo cortocircuita el desarrollo» again distinguishes learning from development, as «amplifies learning versus short-circuits development» does in the source.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"993d7b80927c3a031151","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The three phrases that previously interrupted reading are now «se tambalea», «repasemos el historial» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». They convey the source’s images fluently, so the cited obstacle to a 4/5 readability score is gone.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"fe3c8c8479e5dce0085a","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The source’s «teeters», «historical receipts» and «hand-wringing» are now conveyed by «se tambalea», «repasemos el historial» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». The literal receipt image is lost, but the invitation to examine past panics survives.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"ad7da4881b280c0caa0b","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Enseñar a usarla bien y fomentar la alfabetización en IA» replaces the bureaucratic construction while preserving the source’s call to teach effective use and build literacy. The revised opening and clipped «Espero que los adultos no tarden demasiado» support the direct voice.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"37ef2170dd8bb0f0f5fe","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» is understandable across regions and invites examination of the record, the purpose of the source’s «check our historical receipts». It sacrifices the English slang rather than reproducing the misleading «recibos históricos».","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"4f77ea87f90afbdf804b","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The source and target both contain «date: 2025-05-31». The target also retains the asset basenames, escaped footnote marker and HTML spacer cited in the prior decision; the publication-date omission is fixed.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"e54c07c2cfa3892756cf","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Se tambalea», «repasemos el historial» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras» replace the three malformed phrases identified by peers. Those prominent interruptions no longer prevent fluent reading.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"f1345c8c0b1352cda0fb","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The target keeps the effective «nota de agradecimiento a mano» and now renders the source’s evidence check and anxious lament as «repasemos el historial» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». «Monstruo tecnológico» also recreates the bogeyman image without unexplained slang.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5a97124474a233893a4","verdict":"uphold","severity":2,"reason":"«Hay niños de 12 años que…» presents the example as an independent assertion, whereas the source embeds it in «before we hyperventilate about 12-year-olds». The following «Antes de hiperventilar» reconnects the scene to the panic, so the shift is minor rather than a factual blocker.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"5b32eec3df59a17eb2c5","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«Cortocircuita el desarrollo» recreates the source’s «short-circuits development» and preserves its distinction from «amplifica el aprendizaje». The proposed «desarrollo de sus capacidades» would specify what develops beyond the source’s wording; the current metaphor is intelligible.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"9cc164db4260f1a9d5cd","verdict":"uphold","severity":2,"reason":"«Recursos de clase mundial» conveys «world-class resources», but reads somewhat like promotional wording in an otherwise direct paragraph. «Recursos de primer nivel» would be more natural; this is polish, not a meaning error.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"8140bf7c760e6a8c99c1","verdict":"uphold","severity":2,"reason":"In «Considera el GPS… ganamos la capacidad de navegar con más frecuencia», the GPS context makes «navegar» clear, answering the ambiguity objection. «Orientarnos» would nevertheless read more naturally for the source’s «navigate more often».","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"e302bdc6a769c958e02f","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«La IA seguirá seguramente este patrón» expresses the strong, qualified prediction in «AI will surely follow this pattern.*». The source itself attaches an environmental and dystopian caveat, so «Sin duda» would strengthen the claim beyond what is warranted. The repeated sounds are a stylistic preference, not a substantive defect.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d26720575e4fd2a4c637","verdict":"uphold","severity":2,"reason":"As the prior argument concedes, «Antes de hiperventilar» keeps the example within the panic discussion. Still, «Hay niños de 12 años que…» gives the scene a more declarative framing than the source’s «before we hyperventilate about 12-year-olds»; a small rhetorical adjustment would preserve that framing.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"8c507113204d0e791f96","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«Repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» keeps the source’s invitation to examine evidence, and the surrounding Apple Watch joke retains the dry tone. The English slang in «historical receipts» is lost, but the proposed alternatives are optional stylistic choices rather than necessary repairs.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]}]}
